items.title: Trojan Hippo Bench: A Dynamic Benchmark for Persistent Memory Attacks and Defenses in LLM Agents
items.title_zh: Trojan Hippo Bench：LLM 智能体持久记忆攻击与防御的动态基准
items.summary: Trojan Hippo Bench is a dynamic framework for persistent memory attacks and memory-layer defenses, combining an OpenEvolve-based adaptive red-teaming benchmark with capability-aware security-utility analysis. On an email assistant across four memory backends, the undefended attack reached 85-100% success against frontier OpenAI and Google models, while four defenses cut success to 0-5% at widely varying utility costs.

items.title: Beyond Semantic Similarity: Rethinking Retrieval for Agentic Search via Direct Corpus Interaction
items.title_zh: 超越语义相似度：通过直接语料交互重新思考智能体搜索中的检索
items.summary: The paper studies direct corpus interaction, where an agent searches a raw corpus with general-purpose terminal tools such as grep, file reads and shell commands instead of an embedding index or retrieval API. It reports substantial gains over sparse, dense and reranking baselines on several BRIGHT and BEIR datasets and strong accuracy on BrowseComp-Plus and multi-hop QA.

items.title: 12 Angry AI Agents: Evaluating Multi-Agent LLM Decision-Making Through Cinematic Jury Deliberation
items.title_zh: 十二怒 AI：通过电影式陪审团审议评估多智能体 LLM 决策
items.summary: The study instantiates twelve persona-conditioned LLM agents debating the murder case from 12 Angry Men, testing GPT-4o and Llama-4-Scout across three conditions with 18 total runs. Seventeen of eighteen runs ended in a hung jury, and the models differed sharply in vote changes, which the author links to RLHF intensity rather than model capability.

items.title: Enhancing Judgment Document Generation via Agentic Legal Information Collection and Rubric-Guided Optimization
items.title_zh: Judge-R1：通过智能体法律信息收集与评分标准引导优化增强判决书生成
items.summary: Judge-R1 combines an agentic legal information collection stage, which uses a dynamic planning agent to retrieve precise statutes and precedents from multiple sources, with rubric-guided reinforcement learning using GRPO and a legal reward function. On the JuDGE benchmark it is reported to outperform state-of-the-art baselines in legal accuracy and generation quality.

items.title: Retrieval with Multiple Query Vectors through Anomalous Pattern Detection
items.title_zh: 通过异常模式检测实现多查询向量检索
items.summary: The method takes a set of query vectors, identifies the dimensions that stand out as anomalous, and retrieves database vectors that are also anomalous along those dimensions. Across image, text and tabular datasets, larger query sets generally improved retrieval, with the largest gains when moving from one to eight queries.

items.title: DeepClaude – Claude Code agent loop with DeepSeek V4 Pro
items.title_zh: DeepClaude：用 DeepSeek V4 Pro 驱动 Claude Code 智能体循环
items.summary: A Hacker News front-page discussion of an open-source project that pairs Claude Code's autonomous agent loop with DeepSeek V4 Pro, OpenRouter or any Anthropic-compatible backend, claiming the same UX at 17x lower cost.

items.title: Agentic Coding Is a Trap
items.summary: A front-page Hacker News essay argues that agentic coding is a trap and urges developers to stay vigilant about cognitive debt and skill atrophy.

items.title: Wiki Builder: Skill to Build LLM Knowledge Bases
items.title_zh: Wiki Builder：用于搭建 LLM 知识库的 Claude Code 技能
items.summary: Wiki Builder is an open-source Claude Code plugin that lays out a configurable wiki and lets the agent compile durable pages, indexes and concept maps from chosen sources.
